summary: The Acer Predator Helios Neo 16, equipped with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 and G-Sync display, is experiencing flickering issues when running games in dGPU mode (MUX enabled) but not in Optimus mode. The issue persists even after updating GPU drivers, checking G-Sync settings, and resetting all configurations.
detected_fault: Hardware issue related to the RTX 4060 or G-Sync display
suggested_solution: Run a stress test using tools like FurMark, Unigine Heaven, or Valley to identify potential hardware issues. Perform a clean boot and reinstall the GPU drivers to rule out software conflicts.
